quotes.text: Table 6: Overview of public abdominal CT datasets collected in DeepTumorVQA.

rationale: The paper names the source datasets and gives years/platform-like source links, but the packet does not report source dataset versions or a clear route from each benchmark task to a source record. This meets the partial anchor.

quotes.text: sourced from publicly available, de-identified datasets that have undergone institutional review board (IRB) approval at their respective institutions.
released under CC-BY-4.0

rationale: The packet documents origin, collection from public CT datasets, license terms, and IRB/de-identification status. This satisfies the full provenance and licence anchor.

quotes.text: designed to maximize demographic and pathological diversity

rationale: The paper reports a sampling design and descriptive diversity goals, including centers, regions, protocols, and demographics. It does not compare against a named target population, so the score is partial.

quotes.text: We stratify accuracy by age, sex, CT scanner manufacturer, and contrast phase

rationale: The paper reports subgroup stratification that functions as a bias analysis. It does not report a dedicated unsafe-output test, so only one of the two required test types is present.

quotes.text: Train/test splits are patient-level with zero overlap.
verified by BDMAP-id intersection =0

rationale: The benchmark uses a developer-side held-out patient-level split and reports a measured zero-overlap check for the train/test tool-cache volumes. This satisfies the full anchor.

searched: S1 paper/appendix, S2 README/docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 prompts/tool descriptions. The packet does not state that the agent cannot reach ground truth at run time; oracle mode explicitly provides ground-truth tool values.

quotes.text: All experiments use the following software stack:
All three modes use pre-computed tool caches, so no live segmentation is required.

rationale: The paper reports exact software versions and fixed benchmark data, and the README states that agent tools use precomputed caches rather than live segmentation. The only dynamic model is the model under test.

quotes.text: two practicing radiologists—a junior (7 years experience) and a senior (13 years)

rationale: The packet gives human solvability evidence and model/tool evaluations. It does not report a scripted reference solution run through the grader with its result.

searched: S1 paper/appendix, S2 README/docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 prompts/tool descriptions. The benchmark tasks answer CT VQA questions and call read-only evidence tools; no task changes environment state.

quotes.text: Recognition templates (2-option binary, random baseline 50%):
weighted random baseline of approximately 30–35%.

rationale: The paper reports explicit chance rates for task formats and the benchmark-wide weighted random baseline. That satisfies the full anchor even though some chance rates are high.
searched: S1 paper/appendix, S2 README/docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 prompts/tool descriptions. No public reporting surface gives a do-nothing or random agent score for all tasks.

quotes.text: model rankings are perfectly preserved
we additionally evaluate every model on the full benchmark

rationale: The benchmark validates the MC evaluator against tolerance-based and free-form evaluations on its own model outputs and reports quantitative agreement. This meets the full evaluator-validation anchor.

quotes.text: All inference uses greedy decoding ( temperature=0 , do_sample=False )

rationale: The paper reports deterministic decoding and seed controls. It does not state a repeated-run policy, so it does not reach the full anchor.

quotes.text: 95% binomial CIs are \pm 1.0% at N =10,000
All key findings correspond to medium-to-large effect sizes

rationale: The paper reports confidence intervals and effect sizes for key model comparisons. This satisfies the full statistical comparison anchor.

quotes.text: Training uses seed 42 for data shuffling, weight initialization, and dropout.

rationale: The packet reports seed and deterministic decoding policy. It does not state a number of independent runs behind each headline score or whether runs are independent.

quotes.text: a clustered bootstrap that resamples at the volume level (991 test volumes)

rationale: The paper gives CIs, names binomial/task and volume-level resampling units, and addresses clustering of questions within CT volumes. All three elements are present.

searched: S1 paper/appendix, S2 README/docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 prompts/tool descriptions. The packet reports no identical reruns, action-sequence agreement across reruns, final-state agreement, or pass^k-style metric.

quotes.text: All inference uses greedy decoding ( temperature=0 , do_sample=False )

rationale: Decoding parameters are reported. The model names are mostly family/checkpoint names without provider snapshot IDs or release dates, and no harness tag or commit is stated as matching the reported numbers.

quotes.text: We provide detailed specifications for each of the four diagnostic tools
All three modes use pre-computed tool caches

rationale: The paper and README specify tool inputs and outputs and make clear that tools read from cached evidence rather than mutate state. Public reporting does not fully document error and failure returns for every tool; the read-only side-effect property is not clearly surfaced to the agent in S5.

quotes.text: Tool outputs are sourced from expert annotations (oracle), TotalSegmentator auto-segmentation (predicted), or visual crops (vision)
predicted -- same tools, with TotalSegmentator-derived cache

rationale: The benchmark discloses oracle, predicted, and vision tool behavior, and S5 exposes this disclosure. The packet does not report tests or conformance checks that the tools behave as documented.

searched: S1 paper/appendix, S2 README/docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 prompts/tool descriptions. The benchmark tools retrieve measurements, segmentations, knowledge, or crops; no action changes environment state or represents clinical orders, prescriptions, notes, or messages.

quotes.text: trajectory quality, comprising tool set Jaccard
raw text output is scored under a subtype-appropriate metric

rationale: The grader inputs are named as answer strings and tool trajectories/action logs, and non-state grading is justified through subtype scoring protocols. There is no validation on injected correct and incorrect outcomes with per-class error rates.

quotes.text: training-set images only (strict separation from the test set)
Train/test splits are patient-level with zero overlap.

rationale: The benchmark reports train/test isolation and strict separation for agent SFT tool traces. It does not report canaries or provenance markers, and labels appear to be released rather than held private from every public surface.

rationale: The paper reports results by task family and by demographic/imaging factors. The packet does not provide slice sizes alongside the demographic subgroup results, so the item is partial.
